leader_placement_pending: The leader’s workspace on this computer is not confirmed yet. Retry the worker after the leader is ready.
infer: Cannot infer the task workspace on {machine}; choose a workspace explicitly
unavailable: Workspace {path} is not an available absolute directory
not_found: Workspace {workspace} was not found on {machine}; select a workspace there or enter an absolute path
prepare: Cannot prepare a new task workspace on {machine}; no agent was started
engine_path: The workspace engine returned no absolute checkout path; no agent was started
engine_checkout: The workspace engine did not confirm the requested branch and checkout; no agent was started
busy: Workspace is occupied by task {id} ({title}); wait for it to finish or choose a new workspace (machine {machine}, path {path})
queued: Queued behind task {id} ({title}) on {machine} ({path}); will start automatically when it finishes
queued_after: Queued for {path} on {machine}; waiting for prerequisite task(s) {blockers}
machine_local: The task workspace was prepared on {from}; it cannot move to {to}
create: The new task workspace was not made; no agent was started
no_commits: The repository at {path} on {machine} has no commits yet, so a new task workspace cannot be made from it; commit once or choose an existing workspace. No agent was started
busy_no_commits: Folder {path} on {machine} is in use by task {id} ({title}), and it has no commits, so no new workspace can be made from it; finish that task or start this one in another folder
own_checkout_elsewhere: This to-do's branch {branch} is checked out at {path}, outside the folder for task checkouts, so Persona does not take it over; to continue there, plan the task with workspace {"existing": "{path}"}
own_checkout_dirty: The previous workspace has uncommitted changes. Commit them or save them outside the workspace, then retry (task_retry). You can also choose a different branch in a new workspace.
own_checkout_dirty_files: The previous workspace has uncommitted changes. Commit or stash them, then retry (task_retry). You can also choose a different branch in a new workspace. Changed files include {files}.
own_checkout_in_use: This to-do's earlier checkout {path} (branch {branch}) is in use by Agent {owner}; wait for that Agent to finish or stop it, then start again
own_checkout_unverified: Persona could not confirm that {path} is still this to-do's clean checkout of branch {branch}; check it, then plan the task with workspace {"existing": "{path}"} to continue there, or remove it
own_path_taken: The folder for this task's checkout, {path}, already holds files, so no new checkout was made there; if it is this to-do's earlier work, plan the task with workspace {"existing": "{path}"} to continue there, or remove it
scratch_unsupported: Computer {machine} runs an older Persona Node that does not support managed scratch workspaces; upgrade the node or provide an explicit cwd. No agent was started
scratch_create: The managed scratch workspace was not prepared; no agent was started
scratch_path: The node returned no absolute managed scratch directory path; no agent was started
